title: invoice/header
description: Top band: document title, number, dates and currency.

invoice_date.description: Date exactly as printed on the document (do not reformat), or null

due_date.description: Date exactly as printed on the document (do not reformat), or null

currency.description: ISO currency code, e.g. EUR, USD, GBP

document_type.description: Title of the document if it is not simply 'Invoice' (e.g. 'Tax Invoice'), else null
